# Majid Ali (Majid Alee)

> AI, React Native and backend engineer in Karachi, Pakistan (UTC+5). Technical Operations Lead at Sehat Kahani and founder of Codenetic. Open to senior AI engineering, React Native, backend and forward-deployed roles, remote or in Karachi. Contact: aleemii270@gmail.com

## Work with him
- Full-time: senior AI engineer, React Native lead or backend lead; remote or Karachi
- Freelance and contract through Codenetic: React Native apps from scoping to App Store, backends, AI agents, MCP servers and RAG

## Summary
- 70+ apps published to the App Store and Google Play, out of 300+ built, through his consultancy Codenetic ($200K+ earned)
- Architected Myaigi, a seven-agent LangGraph coaching platform across Claude, OpenAI and Gemini, with a QA agent gating every answer
- Built a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing a production Azure MySQL database as LLM tools
- Cut a national telemedicine platform's Azure bill from about $12,000 to $1,500 a month (88%) with no downtime
- Led 35+ engineers across client accounts as Senior Project Manager; led a four-person backend team on AWS EKS and Fargate
